persuasionAngle.rationale: This persona's biggest barrier isn't features—it's migration anxiety. By showing the actual implementation complexity (minimal) and timeline reality (incremental), we address their core fear of breaking production while giving them technical credibility to evaluate. The honest timeline removes 'too good to be true' skepticism.

creative.headline: Migration doesn't mean big bang
creative.introText: How Notion migrated 100M+ transactions without touching their main checkout flow. Real timeline: 6 months incremental.
creative.linkedinHeadline: The migration approach that doesn't break production
creative.tone: Technically honest, risk-aware, no false promises. Acknowledges migration complexity while showing practical path forward.
